summary: {member} asks the artist to account for the placement of a familiar object in a famous experiment.
realLife: Reviewing a young Franklin flying a kite, members questioned where the key had been drawn and also identified problems with the proportions of his body.
inGame: needs: the sketch of the kite and the reference for its rigging.

turns.what: The artist revisits the position of the key.
turns.writesBack: The revised sketch goes in the packet.
